notes: Accumulation; yog alone collides with shreni.yog lib function, so sankalan used.
Kosh of numbers; element meaning, not container type. If owner wants container in name, use mulya_kosh.
Sum of all; distinct from sum/sankalan so the two names stay distinct.
First numeric list; suchi is the existing list word, pratham distinguishes it from ys.
Parser state array (ptr,len,pos); avastha = state/condition.
Numeric kosh; mala alone is the array keyword, so compound used.
Output value; nirgat = outgoing/output.
Series terms in a kosh; pada = term/step. pad alone is a builtin, pada is distinct.
Scratch buffer (nirmmita); koshtha = receptacle. New word, not in project vocabulary — owner to confirm.
Input numbers; datt = given/data.
Boolean flag; dhvaj = flag/banner.
MIXED name: util (English) + chinha (Sanskrit sign). Drop util, keep chinha; sign flips +1/-1.
Loop-continuation flag (1 = continue); nirantar = continuous.
Counter; ganan does not collide with ganana keyword (R50 tested).
Change in x; x/y are coordinate names, kept, antar = difference.
Change in y; see dx.
Guessed number; anumaan = guess/estimate.
Upper bound; uchcha = high.
Lower bound; nimna = low.
List of numbers; ankavali = number sequence.
Operator code in parser; kriya = operation/action.
Power of three (3^k); shakti is the existing power function name, tri qualifies it.
Remainder; shesh alone is a sadhan lib function, so avashesh used.
Right-hand side in parser; dakshin = right.
Approximation to sqrt(12), refined by iteration; dvadash = twelve, mool = root.
One row of a kosh (Pascal triangle); pankti is the retired array type word, now free as a variable name — owner to confirm reuse is not confusing.
Secret number in guess game; gudh alone is the hash module, so gupt (hidden) used.
Single series term; see terms.
Blended value in 93; name is vague in original, sampurna = whole/complete matches the English name.
Ascending counter; aarohi = ascending.
Base of power shakti(base, exp); aadhar alone is the base-conversion module, so compound used.
Boolean both x>0 and y>0; ubhay = both, dhan = positive.
Call count in guna_once test; ahvan = call/invocation.
Check value flags & 4; pariksha = test/check.
Count from ank_tak_varna; ganan = counting. Same proposal as count (different files, same meaning).
Character code of A; sanket = code/signal. aksharank alone is the builtin, so not used.
Colour enum value; varna alone is the string module, so rang (colour) used.
Cosine series sum; kotijya = cosine (Indian maths), yog = sum.
Cosine series term; kotijya_pad = cosine term, compound, not the pad builtin alone.
Current index/value; vartaman = current/present.
Day number in guna switch; divas = day.
Delta 1.5; see offset.
Denominator 2k+1; har = denominator/divisor.
Descending counter; avarohi = descending.
Difference x-y; bhed = difference.
Doubled value x*2; dvigunit = doubled. dvigun alone is a ganit lib function, so -it form used.
Empty flag (0 = not empty in test); rikta = empty.
Exponent of power; ghatank = exponent/power index.
Bit flags bitmask; dhvaj_gana = group of flags, distinct from flag/dhvaj.
Greeting string Namaste!; namaskar = greeting. abhivadan would clash in spirit with abhivadana function in same file, so namaskar chosen.
Id array (identity); parichay = identity/introduction.
Interest amount; vyaj = interest.
Boolean is_done; sampanna = done/completed.
Boolean is_ready; sajj = ready/prepared.
UNIT: kilograms loop variable. Kilogram is a loanword transliteration — owner may keep kg as the SI symbol instead.
UNIT: kilometres loop variable. Kilomitar is a loanword transliteration, not a native Sanskrit word — owner may keep km as the SI symbol instead.
List of lengths; aayam = length (vartani_aayam), suchi = list.
Code of lowercase a; nimna + akshar (letter).
Average sum/n; madhyaman = mean. madhya alone is a sankhyiki lib function, so not used.
Middle index (lo+hi)/2; madhyank = middle number. madhya alone is a lib function, so not used.
UNIT: miles value. Mail is a loanword transliteration, not a native Sanskrit word — owner may keep miles.
Mixed float value; mishrit = mixed (R50: mishrit follows -it pattern, valid).
Minimum score; kanishth = smallest. laghu alone is a shreni lib function, so not used.
Remainder mod 3 in fizzbuzz; shesh = remainder, tri = three. shesh alone is a lib function, so compound used.
Remainder mod 5; shesh + pancha (five).
Message string from abhivadana; sandesh = message.
Maximum score; brihattam = largest.
Name parameter (string to greet); naam = name.
Negative float -1.25; rin = negative/debt.
Number of segments from split; bhed + ganana (counting).
Count of unique items; vishesh + ganana.
Offset 2; antar = difference/interval. Same proposal as delta (different files, same meaning).
Ok flag array (success channel); siddh = accomplished/successful.
Do-while counter that makes loop run once; ekbar = once/one time.
Parity of a (a % 2); a_shesh = remainder of a.
Split parts array; bhed = division/split. khand alone is the string module, so bhed used, not khand.
Prosody pattern number 13; pratirup = pattern/form.
Parity of b (b % 2); see pa.
Position index; sthan = place/position.
UNIT: pounds value. Paund is a loanword transliteration — owner may keep pounds.
Principal amount 100000; mooldhan = principal capital.
Product x*3; gunanphal = product of multiplication.
List of pointers; sanket = pointer/signal, suchi = list.
Quadrupled value x*4; chaturgun = fourfold.
Interest rate 8; dar = rate.
Raw/unprocessed kosh; kachcha = raw/unripe.
Test score (75, graded A-F); praptank = obtained marks.
List of test scores; praptank + suchi.
Spill value 6.0 in register test; uchchhal = overflow/spill.
Binary-search target; lakshya = target/aim.
Input passage text; paath = text/reading.
Comparison threshold 4.0; seema = limit/boundary.
Temporary length in sort swap; see tp.
Length of text; paath + aayam.
Temporary buffer; asthayi = temporary.
Temporary pointer in sort swap; asthayi = temporary.
Boolean comparison result; tathya = fact/truth. Distinct from yes/parinam.
Constant 2; dvi = two.
Unique lengths array; see uptrs.
Code of uppercase A; uchcha + akshar.
Unique pointers array; vishesh = distinct/unique.
Write buffer for repacking; lekhan = writing, koshtha = receptacle.
Weight factor 1.5; bhar = weight/load.
Written length; lekhan + aayam.
Write position; lekhan + sthan (place).
Year in bank interest (label only, variable is in print string context); varsh = year.
Boolean comparison result; parinam = outcome. satya alone is the bool keyword, so not used.
Second numeric list; dvitiya = second, suchi = list. Paired with xs/pratham_suchi.
